properties.name: A tool name that is not served is answered with the tools its own words find
properties.source: Anthony, 2026-10-09, dev_reflow2 hub (work field log triage)
properties.statement:
When a call names a tool that is not served (--call, --describe, or the read and write verbs), the refusal shall split the name on underscores, run find_tools on those words, and name the top three tools with one line each. It names them and never runs one. Measured case: `query_nodes` would have named scan_nodes, which find_tools ranks 2nd for "query nodes" (fact:a-guessed-tool-name-is-refused-without-the-tool-it-meant-though-find-tools-on-its-own-words-ranks-it-second-2026-10-09).

Anthony, 2026-10-09, kept this as intent when asked which of the field log's four ideas to keep (he kept all four).
